name: MLOps: Machine Learning Operations
certifications: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate
Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate (DP-100)
Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer

beginner.summary: For data scientists, ML engineers and DevOps engineers new to MLOps. Covers the ML lifecycle, project structure, environments, experiment tracking, data versioning, pipelines, model registries, serving with FastAPI, containers, CI, testing code and data, batch inference, monitoring, data validation, orchestration, cloud ML platforms, feature pipelines and responsible release.
prerequisites: Trains models with scikit-learn or similar
outcomes: Make ML work reproducible with Git, environments, MLflow and DVC
Package, serve and containerise models with automated tests and CI
Run batch and real-time inference with monitoring
Release models responsibly with validation and approvals

days.topic: MLOps Overview, Lifecycle and Environment Setup
subtopics: What MLOps is and why models fail in production
The ML lifecycle: data, training, deployment and monitoring
Roles: data scientist, ML engineer, platform engineer
Tool landscape: open source and cloud
Installing Python with uv, Docker and Git
The course project: churn prediction service
days.lab_task: Set up the course environment, clone the churn project, run the training script, list every manual step needed to get the model into use and rate the project against a maturity model.
days.deliverable: Environment set-up, manual step list and maturity rating
checks: At least eight manual steps recorded

days.topic: Project Structure and Git Workflows for ML
subtopics: Branching and pull requests for ML work
What not to commit: data, models and secrets
days.lab_task: Restructure the churn notebook into a package with configuration, add pre-commit hooks for formatting and secret scanning and open a pull request for review.
days.deliverable: Restructured repository and pull request

subtopics: Why "it works on my machine" happens
Lock files with uv or Poetry
days.lab_task: Pin dependencies with a lock file, build a training image, train twice on two machines and get the same metric, then show a version change that alters results.
days.deliverable: Lock file, Dockerfile and reproduction results
checks: Same metric to four decimal places

days.lab_task: Run an MLflow tracking server, log 20 training runs with different settings, compare them in the UI and pick the best run with a reason.
days.deliverable: Tracked experiment and selection note
checks: All 20 runs with parameters and metrics
Best run chosen by the agreed metric
Same metric from the logged parameters

subtopics: Storing data in S3 or Azure Blob
Linking data versions to code commits
Large files and Git LFS compared
days.lab_task: Track the churn dataset with DVC in remote storage, add a new month of data, train on both versions and switch back to the old version to reproduce an earlier model.
days.deliverable: DVC configuration, data versions and reproduction notes
checks: Data in remote storage, not in Git

subtopics: Steps: prepare, featurise, train and evaluate
When to move to an orchestrator
days.lab_task: Turn training into a DVC pipeline, change one parameter and show only affected steps re-run, and compare metrics between two branches.
days.deliverable: Pipeline definition, run output and comparison

days.topic: Model Packaging and the Model Registry
days.lab_task: Package the churn pipeline as an MLflow model with a signature, register three versions, set champion and challenger aliases and load the champion in a script.
days.deliverable: Registered model versions and loading script
checks: Send input with a wrong column
Use, data, metrics and limits recorded

days.lab_task: Serve the champion model with FastAPI, validate inputs, add health endpoints, load test it with Locust and record latency percentiles.
days.deliverable: API code, load test results and API docs
checks: p95 latency recorded at the target rate

days.lab_task: Build a small, non-root image for the model API with a multi-stage build, scan it, run it with Compose next to MLflow and push it to a registry with a versioned tag.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, Compose file, scan report and pushed image

days.topic: Configuration, Secrets and Logging for ML Services
subtopics: Configuration files with Hydra or pydantic-settings
Secrets in environment variables and vaults
Request IDs and model versions in logs
Log levels for training and serving
tools: HashiCorp Vault or a cloud secret store
days.lab_task: Move settings for training and the API into typed configuration per environment, read the database password from a secret store and add structured logs with request IDs and model versions.
days.deliverable: Configuration files, secret set-up and log samples
checks: No secrets in code or configuration files
Request ID and model version present, no personal data

subtopics: Training on a sample in CI
CML for reports in pull requests
days.lab_task: Build a CI workflow that lints, tests, trains on a sample, fails if the metric drops below a threshold, posts a metric report on the pull request and builds the image.
days.deliverable: Workflow and a pull request with a report
checks: Lower model quality on a branch
CI fails on the metric threshold
Metric report posted as a comment

days.topic: Testing ML Code, Data and Models
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for feature functions, property-based tests with Hypothesis, behaviour tests that check predictions change in the expected direction and a fairness check.
days.deliverable: Test suite and results
checks: Gap between groups within the limit

days.lab_task: Score a million customers nightly in chunks, write predictions with model version and run date, make re-runs safe and alert when the job fails.
days.deliverable: Batch job, output table and alert
checks: Model version and date on every row

subtopics: What to monitor: service, data and model
days.lab_task: Log predictions from the API, build service and prediction dashboards, run a drift report against training data and alert when drift crosses a threshold.
days.deliverable: Monitoring set-up, dashboards, drift report and alert
checks: Latency, errors and prediction mix shown

subtopics: Checks on ranges, nulls and categories
days.lab_task: Add data checks to the pipeline and the API, block training when a new category appears, warn on rising nulls and publish a data quality report.
days.deliverable: Validation rules, pipeline changes and report
checks: Training blocked with a clear message
Send bad input to the API

days.topic: Orchestrating ML Workflows with Airflow or Prefect
days.lab_task: Orchestrate monthly retraining: validate data, train, evaluate against the champion, register if better and notify the team, with retries on flaky steps.
days.deliverable: DAG or flow definition and run history
checks: Run a backfill for two months

days.topic: Cloud ML Platforms: SageMaker, Azure ML and Vertex AI
days.lab_task: Train and deploy the churn model on one managed platform, compare effort and cost with the self-managed setup and record what moves easily between platforms.
days.deliverable: Managed deployment, cost comparison and portability notes

subtopics: Features computed in training and serving
When to adopt a feature store
days.lab_task: Find a training-serving skew bug in the churn service, fix it with shared feature code, add point-in-time joins for training and compare logged serving features with training features.
days.deliverable: Fix, shared feature module and skew report
checks: No future data in training rows

days.topic: Responsible Model Release: Reviews, Approvals and Documentation
days.lab_task: Define release criteria, run the new model in shadow mode for a day, get approval through a protected environment, release it and roll back on purpose to test the plan.
days.deliverable: Release criteria, shadow results, approval record and rollback evidence

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Production Churn Prediction Service
days.lab_task: Deliver the churn model end to end: versioned data, a tested training pipeline, a registry, a containerised API with CI, batch scoring, monitoring with drift alerts and an approved release, then demo a rollback.
days.deliverable: Repository, pipeline, deployed service, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Reproduce training from a clean clone
Same metric as the registered model
Send drifted data in the demo
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one service

intermediate.summary: For ML engineers and platform engineers who run models in production. Covers Kubernetes for ML, Kubeflow Pipelines, serving with KServe, BentoML and Triton, feature stores, canary and shadow deployment, drift-driven retraining, model governance, Azure ML, SageMaker, Vertex AI, distributed training, tuning at scale, Spark pipelines, infrastructure as code, security, cost, serving LLMs with vLLM, evaluating LLM applications and observability.
prerequisites: Has tracked experiments, packaged models and served them with an API
outcomes: Run ML pipelines and model serving on Kubernetes and cloud platforms
Deploy models progressively and retrain automatically
Govern, secure and cost-control ML systems

days.lab_task: Run training as a Kubernetes Job on a GPU node, schedule nightly scoring with a CronJob, deploy the model API with a Helm chart and debug a pod stuck pending.
days.deliverable: Manifests, Helm chart and debugging notes
checks: Cause found in events and fixed

days.lab_task: Build a Kubeflow pipeline for validate, train, evaluate and register, use caching, schedule recurring runs and trace a model back to its data in the lineage view.
days.deliverable: Pipeline code, runs and lineage screenshot
checks: Model linked to its dataset and run

days.topic: Model Serving at Scale with KServe, BentoML and Triton
days.lab_task: Serve the same model with KServe and BentoML, serve an image model on Triton with dynamic batching, and benchmark latency and cost per thousand predictions.
days.deliverable: Serving configurations and benchmark table
checks: Send no traffic for a while
Cost per thousand predictions for each

days.lab_task: Define churn features in Feast, build a point-in-time training set, materialise features to Redis and look them up in the model API.
days.deliverable: Feature definitions, training set and API changes
checks: No values from after each label date
Second model uses the same feature view

days.topic: Progressive Model Deployment: Shadow, Canary and A/B Tests
subtopics: Traffic splitting with KServe or Istio
Bandits for model choice in brief
days.lab_task: Deploy a challenger in shadow, then as a 10 percent canary with automatic rollback on error rate, and run an A/B test on a business metric.
days.deliverable: Deployment configuration, rollout results and A/B analysis
checks: Effect on the business metric with an interval

subtopics: Retraining triggers: schedule, drift and performance
days.lab_task: Detect drift on incoming data, trigger the retraining pipeline, compare the new model with the champion on recent labelled data and require a human approval before promotion.
days.deliverable: Drift monitors, trigger configuration and approval record

tools: Unity Catalog or a model inventory
days.lab_task: Build a model inventory with owners and risk ratings, capture lineage with OpenLineage, restrict registry access by role and reproduce a prediction made last month.
days.deliverable: Inventory, lineage graph, access rules and reproduction evidence
checks: Same output from stored model and features
Try to promote without the role
Prediction traced to data and code versions

days.lab_task: Build an Azure ML pipeline, register the model, deploy a managed endpoint with blue-green traffic and automate it from GitHub Actions.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, endpoint and workflow

days.lab_task: Build a SageMaker pipeline that trains, evaluates and registers the model, deploy a serverless endpoint after approval and set up Model Monitor for data quality.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, endpoint and monitor configuration

days.lab_task: Train from BigQuery data in a Vertex AI pipeline, deploy two model versions with a traffic split and turn on skew and drift monitoring.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, endpoint and monitoring configuration

days.lab_task: Train an image model on one and then four GPUs with DDP and mixed precision, fix a data loading bottleneck and resume from a checkpoint after interruption.
days.deliverable: Training scripts, scaling results and checkpoint test

subtopics: When tuning is not worth it
days.lab_task: Tune the model with Ray Tune across a cluster with early stopping, log trials to MLflow and compare the gain and cost with a small random search.
days.deliverable: Tuning code, MLflow runs and cost comparison
checks: Metric gain and cost for both

days.topic: Data Pipelines for ML with Spark
subtopics: When data is too big for pandas
Writing feature tables in Delta or Parquet
days.lab_task: Build monthly customer features from 500 million events with Spark, write them partitioned in Delta, check quality and train from the feature table.
days.deliverable: Spark job, feature table and training run
checks: Checks pass or block the write

days.topic: Infrastructure as Code for ML Platforms
days.lab_task: Define an ML platform with Terraform and Argo CD (cluster, storage, MLflow and serving), deploy it to two environments and rebuild staging from scratch.
days.deliverable: Terraform code, GitOps repository and rebuild log
checks: Platform back with no manual steps
Change a Helm value in Git

subtopics: Model files and unsafe formats such as pickle
days.lab_task: Scan model files for unsafe code, switch to a safe format, scan images, require signed images in the cluster and add authentication and rate limits to the endpoint.
days.deliverable: Scan results, policies and endpoint configuration
checks: Load a malicious pickle in the scan
Call the endpoint without a token

days.lab_task: Measure cost per training run and per thousand predictions, move training to spot capacity, scale serving to zero at night and report savings.
days.deliverable: Cost report before and after
checks: Training completes with checkpoints at lower cost

days.topic: Serving Large Language Models with vLLM
days.lab_task: Serve an open model with vLLM behind an OpenAI-compatible API, compare a quantised version for throughput and quality and estimate cost against a managed API.
days.deliverable: Serving configuration, benchmark and cost comparison
checks: Call the API with an OpenAI client
Self-hosted and managed costs per million tokens

subtopics: Why LLM apps need evaluation pipelines
Regression tests on prompts and models
days.lab_task: Build an evaluation set of 50 questions for a RAG app, score retrieval and answers, run the evaluation in CI on every prompt change and block a change that lowers quality.
days.deliverable: Evaluation set, pipeline and CI results
checks: Change a prompt for the worse

days.lab_task: Add metrics and traces to the serving stack, define SLOs for latency and prediction quality, build team dashboards and write runbooks for each alert.
days.deliverable: Instrumentation, SLOs, dashboards and runbooks
checks: Trace through API, feature store and model
Alert fires with a runbook link

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Automated ML Platform on Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Build an ML platform as code with pipelines, a feature store, KServe serving with canary releases, drift-triggered retraining with approval, security policies and cost reporting, then demo a full retraining and release cycle.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, pipelines, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Retraining, evaluation, approval and canary release run end to end
Cost per model and per prediction shown
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For ML platform leads, senior ML engineers and architects. Covers platform architecture, multi-tenancy, real-time ML, GPU cluster scheduling, operating LLM and RAG systems, fine-tuning pipelines, model optimisation, regulation and model risk, ML supply chain security, reliability engineering, AI FinOps, edge MLOps, privacy-preserving ML, experimentation platforms, labelling operations, developer experience, incident response, platform migration and MLOps strategy.
prerequisites: Runs ML pipelines and serving in production
Uses Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD
Has deployed models with monitoring and retraining
outcomes: Design multi-tenant ML and LLM platforms
Run real-time, GPU-heavy and edge workloads reliably and cost-effectively
Meet regulation, security and privacy requirements
Lead MLOps strategy, adoption and incident response

subtopics: Training, serving, features and monitoring layers
Batch, real-time and LLM workloads together
days.lab_task: Design an ML platform for a company with 40 data scientists and both classical and LLM workloads, choose build or buy per layer and defend the design in a review.
days.deliverable: Architecture, decision records and review notes
checks: Each choice justified with cost and risk
Batch, real-time and LLM paths covered

days.lab_task: Set up three team tenants with quotas, priorities and data isolation, provide a self-service project template and show one team cannot read another's models.
days.deliverable: Tenant configuration, templates and isolation tests
checks: Create a project from the template

days.topic: Real-Time ML: Streaming Features and Online Inference
subtopics: Streaming features with Kafka and Flink
Consistency between batch and stream features
tools: Apache Flink or Spark Structured Streaming
days.lab_task: Build a fraud score service with streaming features from Kafka, an online store and a model under a 50 ms p99 budget, and check stream features against batch features.
days.deliverable: Streaming pipeline, service and latency results

days.lab_task: Share a GPU pool between training and inference with Kueue priorities, split a GPU with MIG for small models, run a gang-scheduled Ray job and report utilisation.
days.deliverable: Scheduling configuration and utilisation report
checks: Three small models on one GPU
GPU use before and after changes

days.topic: Operating LLM and RAG Systems in Production
days.lab_task: Put a RAG assistant into production with versioned prompts, a nightly index rebuild, guardrails, tracing, semantic caching and cost alerts, then roll back a bad prompt.
days.deliverable: Production configuration, traces and rollback evidence
checks: Cost and latency lower for repeated questions

days.topic: Fine-Tuning Pipelines for Open-Weight Language Models
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that prepares data, fine-tunes an open model with QLoRA, evaluates it against the base model and serves the adapter with vLLM.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, evaluation report and served adapter
checks: No large drop on a general test set

days.topic: Model Optimisation for Serving: Quantisation, Pruning and Compilation
days.lab_task: Export a model to ONNX, quantise it, compile it with TensorRT and compare latency, cost and accuracy with the original.
days.deliverable: Optimised models and comparison table

days.topic: Regulation, Model Risk and Responsible AI Operations
subtopics: India's DPDP Act and data use
days.lab_task: Classify five company models under the EU AI Act, complete documentation for a high-risk model, add production bias monitoring and prepare an evidence pack.
days.deliverable: Classification, documentation, monitoring and evidence pack
checks: Each placed in a risk category with reasons

subtopics: SBOMs and AI bill of materials
days.lab_task: Sign models and images in the pipeline, verify signatures at deploy time, produce an AI bill of materials and respond to a simulated compromised public model.
days.deliverable: Signing set-up, AI BOM and incident response notes

days.lab_task: Define SLOs and fallbacks for the fraud service, inject failures in the feature store and model server and show the service degrades safely within its error budget.
days.deliverable: SLOs, fallbacks and chaos test results

subtopics: Cost per prediction and per token
Cost allocation by team and product
Build compared with buy for models
days.lab_task: Calculate unit cost for three AI features, allocate spend by team, cut LLM spend with routing to smaller models and caching, and present a quarterly cost review.
days.deliverable: Unit cost model, allocation report and review
checks: Cost per prediction or request for each feature

days.topic: Edge MLOps: Deploying Models to Devices
subtopics: Model formats for devices: TFLite, ONNX and Core ML
tools: Azure IoT Edge or AWS IoT Greengrass
days.lab_task: Convert a model for edge devices, deploy it to a simulated fleet with staged updates, collect monitoring data when online and roll back a bad update.
days.deliverable: Edge model, deployment configuration and monitoring data
checks: Roll out to 10 percent of devices
Devices return to the previous model

days.lab_task: Train a model with differential privacy, run a federated training round across three simulated clients, test for membership inference and plan how to honour a deletion request.
days.deliverable: Private training results, federated run and privacy test
checks: Risk lower for the private model
Steps to remove data and retrain defined

days.lab_task: Set up an experimentation service, run a model A/B test with guardrails and sequential analysis and link the result to the model release decision.
days.deliverable: Experiment configuration, analysis and release decision

days.topic: Data Labelling Operations and Human Feedback
days.lab_task: Run a labelling workflow with two labellers, measure agreement, use active learning to choose what to label next and show the model gain per thousand labels.
days.deliverable: Labelling set-up, agreement report and learning curve
checks: Active learning gains more per label
New labels used in the next run

days.topic: Developer Experience and Golden Paths for ML Teams
days.lab_task: Interview two data scientists about friction, build a golden path template from notebook to deployed model, measure time to first deployment and survey satisfaction.
days.deliverable: Interview notes, template and measurements
checks: A new user deploys without help

days.lab_task: Run a drill for a model producing harmful predictions after a data pipeline change: detect it, roll back model and data, communicate and write the post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Drill timeline, communications and post-incident review
checks: Alert or report leads to triage within the target
Model and data restored to the last good version

days.lab_task: Plan a migration of 20 models from a self-managed stack to a cloud platform, migrate two with their registry history, validate predictions match and plan decommissioning.
days.deliverable: Migration plan, migrated models and validation report

subtopics: Team structures: central, embedded and hybrid
Change management for data science teams
days.lab_task: Assess a company's MLOps maturity, design the team structure, write a 12-month roadmap with measures and present it to a role-play executive team.
days.deliverable: Assessment, team design, roadmap and presentation

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise ML and LLM Platform
days.lab_task: Design and deliver a multi-tenant platform for classical and LLM workloads: GPU scheduling, real-time features, progressive delivery, LLM operations, supply chain security, regulatory documentation and FinOps, then run a game day with a model incident and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, platform code, game day report and board presentation
checks: Detected, rolled back and reviewed within targets
Cost per prediction and per request by team
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
Run ML and LLMs at enterprise scale
